key_insight: Retinal OCT finding recognition outpaced visual localization: the best general-purpose model achieved 23.7% grounding macro F1, rising to 33.9% with OCT-specific RetGrounder.
clinical_relevance: Localizing reported retinal abnormalities is important for assessing whether AI image interpretations are grounded in visible findings.
method: Created RetinaGroundBench with ophthalmologist-annotated bounding boxes for retinal OCT biomarkers.
Introduced AggIoU to assess coverage when models split a lesion across multiple predicted boxes.
Evaluated 27 open-source MLLMs and fine-tuned the 8B RetGrounder using grounding and textual information.
evidence_signal: The benchmark includes 815 B-scans, 4,537 bounding boxes, 13 biomarkers and 8 diseases; RetGrounder improved grounding F1 by 43% relative to the best general-purpose model.
watch_item: Grounding performance remains limited, and the abstract does not establish clinical deployment readiness or generalization beyond this benchmark.
paper_title: A Visual Grounding Benchmark for Retinal OCT with Multimodal Large Language Models
